members.name: hosq
members.carry: The frame itself. hosq builds the Notations Laboratory — twelve days of collective work in the State Philharmonia, closed by a two-day public festival. This year the material is Rituals: structured, repeatable actions that shape how we hold time, space, and each other.

project.title: Notations #2 — Rituals
project.desc: 65 artists · Jul 20–31 laboratory · Aug 1–2 festival · State Philharmonia + National Gallery, Yerevan.
project.label: hosq.co →

members.name: Gevorg Aram Grigoryan
members.role: video art curation · multimedia artist · di. studio
members.carry: The bridge you are standing on. br_id_ge is his crossing: the rite, the field, the platform beneath them — di.iiii — where every crossing becomes permanent shared space. The vi.ritual is his notation for Rituals.

project.title: br_id_ge XR_ Notations:vi.ritual
project.desc: Cross a bridge of Armenian letters, answer the Keeper, leave your core. Every visitor of the festival is a small part of this work; every artist here is a large one.
project.label: cross the bridge →
